topic: rapid status round in a busy operations room

utterances.text: Quick status round. Keep each update brief.
Network is stable, with one backup route active.
Power is normal and the battery test passed.
Audio channels are armed, but channel six is slightly noisy.
Video synchronization is within one frame.
The east aisle must remain clear.
The final equipment case arrives in ten minutes.
Software checks are complete except for one warning.
The replacement interface is connected and ready.
I need a fresh checksum after the next save.
Support has two people standing by.
I am logging decisions and unresolved items.
Good. What is the warning from software?
A temporary file was left from yesterday, nothing is corrupted.
Please remove it before the checksum.
Can someone confirm whether channel six is required?
Not for video, but we may need it for the room feed.
I can swap the cable without stopping the system.
Wait until the aisle is clear before moving it.
The delivery team is entering now.
Battery load remains steady.
Backup traffic just returned to the primary route.
No new support requests.
All updates are recorded.
Then proceed with the cable swap and final verification.
